text:
alice: Preflight: planning to run live tenant_backfill at 03:00 UTC in the quiesce window. Staging run showed transient row lock spikes (~10-15s). Opening thread to confirm rollback criteria, version pin, and throttle settings.

ben: ack. I'll watch lockwatch. Can you paste the staging wait snippet?

alice: staging tail: 
```
2026-03-20 03:12:45 UTC [shard-3] PID 2345 waiting for row exclusive lock on tenant_data (granted=false)
2026-03-20 03:12:46 UTC [shard-3] PID 2360 holder PID 2311
2026-03-20 03:12:58 UTC [shard-3] PID 2345 wait 13s
```

deploybot: Automated: Canary job tenant_backfill started (id: dbbf-2026-03-21-03). Progress pings every 5m.

charlie: Proposal: If >3 concurrent lock waits each >30s across >2 shards -> auto-pause backfill, escalate to #eng-oncall, reduce batch_size. Otherwise continue.

diane: +1. Pin migration tool to v2.4.1 for this run (v2.5 changed batching heuristics).

ben: mitigation on pause: set batch_size=128 and enable KV cache; manual rollback if deadlocks escalate.

infra-bot: Watch `backfill_long_waits` created -> will open incident if threshold crossed.

alice: Runbook: 1) Preflight: `select count(*) from pg_locks where granted = false;` if >0 delay start 5m. 2) On breach: deploybot auto-pause + set batch_size=128 + KV cache on, retry up to 3x. 3) If still failing -> stop backfill, revert migration flag, open incident, pin traffic to fallback.

charlie: Also ensure `deploybot job snapshot <id>` is emitted for reproducibility.

diane: I'll post release note: "Running live tenant_backfill (migration-tool v2.4.1) during quiesce window; auto-pause on long lock waits."

erica: oncall standing by for alerts; will coordinate with infra for rollback if needed.

alice: kicking at 03:00 UTC. will post updates here. :rocket:
